rapport_notes: Friendly, thorough logistics discovery, but the call ended before pricing when the customer disengaged.

evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer wanted junk removal of a broken cabinet; rep said 'unfortunately we cannot assist you with the trunk removal services... will you be able to dispose it before we move you?' then moved straight to the next logistics question with no follow-up.

top_strength: Thorough, efficient logistics discovery (elevator access, packing needs, both addresses) in a short call.
coaching_note: Customer disengaged and declined before pricing was ever reached ('I think I'm good, no need on the quote') — asking the agenda/concerns question early might have surfaced the junk-removal need as a real objection to work through instead of a flat no.
